strings.name: Steve Ballmer
strings.summary: A Harvard graduate, Ballmer joined Microsoft in 1980 and served as CEO from 2000 to 2014. He oversaw expansion in enterprise software, servers and games, alongside mobile setbacks. He later bought the Los Angeles Clippers and launched USAFacts. In 2026 the NBA found salary-cap circumvention, banning him for one year and penalizing the team.
